description: Revoke a hosted shareable report link by its token. Once revoked, the public URL returns a 404 and no longer exposes the report. This action cannot be undone.

token.description: The share token to revoke. Required.

name: revoke_share

outputSchema.description: Revocation acknowledgement. The route replies 204 with no body, which the client renders as a bare success flag.

success.description: True when the share was revoked.
